name: sts-photofinish
description: STS Photo Finish — photo finish arung jeram & kayak, terhubung ke sts-timingsystem

scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.agent:render: pm2 delete pf-agent-render >/dev/null 2>&1; bash scripts/run-agent-render.sh --check && pm2 start scripts/run-agent-render.sh --name pf-agent-render --interpreter bash --time --restart-delay 3000 --max-restarts 50 && echo 'Agent berjalan di latar. Log: npm run agent:render:logs · Berhenti: npm run agent:render:stop'
scripts.agent:render:status: pm2 status pf-agent-render && bash scripts/agent-autostart.sh status
